subject: Meteorology
title: The Asian-Australian Monsoon
description: Learn The Asian-Australian Monsoon in one minute.

hook.text: The Asian-Australian monsoon is the largest monsoon system—spanning from India to Australia and East Asia.

buildup.text: In Northern Hemisphere summer, the monsoon flows northward into Asia; in winter, it reverses southward to Australia.

discovery.text: The Tibetan Plateau amplifies the Asian monsoon—its intense heating creates a powerful upper-level high-pressure system.

twist.text: The Australian monsoon brings a wet season to the Top End from December to March—reversed from the Asian cycle.

climax.text: This massive system links the weather of billions across two continents—disruptions ripple through global patterns.

punchline.text: Two continents sharing one giant seasonal wind machine.
